articles.title: 'Emergency brake not working': Video captures moments leading to Assam train derailment
articles.summary: A chilling video captures the moments before the Kolkata-Sairang Express derailed near Guwahati, with the driver heard reporting a red signal and a non-functional emergency system before the locomotive hits barricades with a loud thud. The locomotive and five coaches derailed at Digaru railway station on Wednesday morning.

articles.title: NLU Delhi extends AILET 2027 application form deadline, apply by November 13
articles.summary: National Law University Delhi has extended the AILET 2027 application deadline to November 13. Registered candidates can complete fee payment by November 14 and make corrections to their application forms by 8 am on November 15.

articles.title: CLAT 2027 mock test 1 link active at consortiumofnlus.ac.in; check steps to attempt
articles.summary: The Consortium of National Law Universities has activated the CLAT 2027 Mock Test 1 link for UG and PG candidates. They can attempt the online practice test to assess their preparation ahead of the December 6 entrance examination.

articles.title: NCERT conducts five-day NISHTHA training for Delhi teachers, focuses on NEP 2020, new textbooks and classroom reforms
articles.summary: The NCERT and SCERT Delhi conducted a five-day teacher training programme under the Reimagined NISHTHA initiative from November 2 to 6, 2026. Organised under Samagra Shiksha, the programme focused on NEP 2020, updated NCERT textbooks, teaching methodologies, inclusive education, assessment practices and the Holistic Progress Card to strengthen classroom implementation..

articles.title: Mizoram Board HSLC, HSSLC timetable 2027 out; check Class 10, 12 subject-wise exam dates
articles.summary: The Mizoram Board of School Education (MBSE) has released the 2027 HSLC and HSSLC examination timetables. The Class 10 exams will begin on February 10, while Class 12 exams will start on February 8.

articles.title: New mugshot released after ankle monitor incident
articles.summary: Thomas Markle, the estranged father of Meghan Markle, has been taken back into custody in Florida after allegedly removing his court-ordered ankle monitor. Reports say authorities also released his latest mugshot following the incident on Tuesday, November 10..

articles.title: 'Ramayana' box office collection day 6 (LIVE)
articles.summary: The blockbuster Ramayana: Part 1, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, is making waves in cinemas. With a remarkable net collection of Rs 346.35 crore in India over five days and a worldwide gross touching Rs 663.90 crore, the film is on a path to reaching Rs 700 crore post-Monday's earnings.
